title: بادبادک و باد
logline_fa: بادبادکی کاغذی روی تپه‌ای ساکت منتظر است؛ وقتی باد می‌آید و موسیقی بالا می‌رود، بادبادک با دمِ بلندش می‌رقصد و در اوج، بی‌نخ می‌شود و آزاد می‌ماند.

protagonist.what: a diamond kite with a face and a tail of bows
protagonist.build: SVG polygon + 2 dot eyes + tail as a chain of small bows following the head with delayed offsets; wind as one scalar
protagonist.state_change: limp on the ground -> trembling -> dancing in the wind -> free without string

beats.what: wind rises, music builds, kite lifts
beat drop: near silence then hit
dance, tail swirls, camera follows up
string snaps, kite stays in the air, copy

payoffs.viewer_gets: the whole world snaps into motion

sound.hit: kick + sub boom exactly on the drop

payoffs.viewer_gets: tail loops a figure-eight on the beat

assets: SVG kite, hill, clouds, bow chain
kit music excerpt with a drop (or 2 excerpts joined by a riser), gust and snap sfx

tests: emotional music-led pacing with a drop
likely_skill_gaps: no beat-grid lookup from a music excerpt
no pa tool to find the drop time in a kit track
acceptance: drop hit offset <= 5 ms vs kit track drop time
pacing: visual speed ratio after/before the drop > 1.5
pa audio-check: LUFS in range, no clipping at the drop
lab.risk: medium; finding the drop in the kit music
